decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not commence until samples of the external insulation and timber outbuilding materials to be used of the external surfaces have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority.</p><p>The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<span style="font-size:12pt">The Air Source Heat Pump (ASHP) unit hereby permitted shall be operated in accordance&nbsp; with the&nbsp;<span style="height:25.65pt">Micro-generation Certificate Scheme (MCS 020) planning standards and</span>&nbsp;shall not exceed a noise level of 42dB(A) LAeq, 5 minutes, as measured at the boundary&nbsp;of a neighbouring residential property.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>

<span style="font-size:12pt">All other materials (excluding external insulation and timber outbuilding/enclosure)&nbsp;to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the external alterations&nbsp;hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.<br><br></span>
description: Alterations to front porch roof to raise height, External wall insulation to lower ground, ground and first floor front elevation, External wall insulation to side elevation, External wall insulation to lower ground floor rear elevation, Replacement windows to front, side and rear elevations, Replacement of door with window in lower ground side elevation and ground floor rear elevation, Alterations to roof to replace tiles and rear dormers, Detached single storey outbuilding to front to house air source heat pump (Demolition of gas tanks on side elevation, antenna on side elevation, steel staircase to rear) and all associated works
